title: AIR INDUCTION SYSTEM - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What is the procedure for disconnecting and reassembling the induction air elbow and related components?
answer: Remove System Components . (1)  Loosen fasteners securing air filter bracket to lower cowl. Remove air filter bracket and air filter. (2)  Remove lower cowl. Refer to Cowling - Maintenance Practices. (3)  Loosen clamps on duct to disconnect filter box from induction air elbow. (4)  To remove induction air elbow, loosen clamps at inlet adapter and at drain line. Slide induction air elbow down and away from inlet adaptor.Install System Components . Position induction air elbow to inlet adaptor and secure using clamp. Secure drain line to induction air elbow using clamp. Install lower cowl. Refer to Cowling - Maintenance Practices. Secure air filter and air filter bracket to lower cowl using quick release fasteners.

title: AIR INDUCTION SYSTEM - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: How does ram air reach the cylinders in the engine's induction system?
answer: Ram air to the engine enters the induction air box through the induction filter, located in the forward part of the lower engine cowling. From the induction air box, the air is directed to the inlet of the fuel/air control unit and, ultimately, through individual intake runners into their respective cylinders.For a more comprehensive description of how the air induction system relates to fuel injection, refer to Chapter 73, Fuel Injection System - Description and Operation.
